title: cnpg-database
description: A logical Database inside an existing CNPG cluster (CNPG 1.28+ declarative database management), for a consumer that owns its database but not the cluster. See docs/reference.md.

databaseName.description: PostgreSQL database name (spec.name on the rendered Database). Required.

clusterName.description: Name of the existing CNPG Cluster this database belongs to. Required.

namespace.description: Namespace the Database CR is rendered into. Required.

owner.description: PostgreSQL role that owns this database. Defaults to 'app'.

allowedConsumers.description: RETIRED (ADR-026): previously generated a CiliumNetworkPolicy ingress rule per entry. Kept as a no-op for values compatibility; per-install NetworkPolicies live in the consuming chart now.
